'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mali War]]
**[[Tuareg people|Tuareg]] fighters from the [[Permanent Strategic Framework for Peace, Security, and Development|Platform]] coalition of rebels capture the town of [[Bourem]] from Malian forces, bringing an end to the 2015 peace treaty between the rebels and the Malian government. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/09/12/mali-armed-groups-from-the-north-claim-the-capture-of-bourem// (Africanews)]
'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Storm Daniel]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s caused by Storm Daniel in northeastern [[Libya]] increases to 6,000 people, with thousands more reported missing. [[Government of National Stability]] minister [[Hisham Chkiouat]] confirms that entire neighbourhoods have been destroyed in [[Derna, Libya|Derna]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2023/9/12/libya-floods-live-news-thousands-dead-missing-in-derna-after-storm-daniel (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-66785466 (BBC News)] [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/09/13/africa/libya-flooding-storm-daniel-wednesday-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*At [[Salzburg Zoo]] in [[Austria]], a [[zookeeper]] is killed and another is injured by a [[rhinoceros]] in its enclosure. The zoo remains closed. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/classified-odd/09/12/23/rhino-kills-keeper-injures-another-in-austria-zoo (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[New South Wales]] [[Government of New South Wales|government]] in [[Australia]] bans [[Illegal logging|logging]] in a 8,400-[[hectare]] [[Forests of Australia|forest]] area, identified as home to 106 "[[koala]] hubs", as part of a [[Koala conservation|conservation]] effort to establish a 315,000-hectare Great Koala National Park. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/science-environment/20230912-australia-logging-ban-to-create-koala-haven (AFP via RFI)]

'''International relations'''
*[[North Korea–Russia relations]]
**[[2023 North Korea–Russia summit]]
***[[Supreme Leader (North Korean title)|North Korean leader]] [[Kim Jong Un]] arrives in [[Russia]] for a [[summit (meeting)|summit]] with [[President of Russia|President]] [[Vladimir Putin]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/north-korea-kim-jong-un-russia-vladimir-putin-ukraine-rcna104563 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[1Malaysia Development Berhad scandal]]
**The [[Malaysian Court of Appeal]] upholds the [[acquittal]] of former [[Prime Minister of Malaysia|prime minister]] [[Najib Razak]] and former [[1Malaysia Development Berhad|1MDB]] chief [[Arul Kanda Kandasamy]] on [[criminal charge|charges]] of [[audit]] [[Tampering (crime)|tampering]] related to the [[sovereign wealth fund]]'s [[corruption in Malaysia|corruption]] investigation. [https://www.thejakartapost.com/world/2023/09/12/malaysian-court-upholds-najibs-audit-tampering-acquittal.html (AFP via ''The Jakarta Post'')]
*[[Impeachment inquiry into Joe Biden]]
**[[Kevin McCarthy]], the speaker of the [[United States House of Representatives]], announces an impeachment inquiry into President Joe Biden. This inquiry led by Representative [[James Comer (politician)|James Comer]] will be conducted by the [[United States House Committee on the Judiciary|House's Judiciary Committee]], [[United States House Committee on Oversight and Accountability|Oversight Committee]] and [[United States House Committee on Ways and Means|Ways and Means Committee]]. [https://apnews.com/article/hunter-biden-congress-oversight-republicans-impeachment-57c5b1b40d19ede4ecf7fde08c027cee (Associated Press)]
*A [[Regional Trial Court]] in [[Pasig]], [[Philippines]], acquits [[Rappler|Rappler Holdings Corporation]] and its [[CEO]], [[Nobel Peace Prize]] awardee [[Maria Ressa]], in the fifth and final [[tax evasion]] case against the corporation. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/09/11/media/philippines-maria-ressa-tax-acquittal-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]

''' Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Guatemalan general election#Aftermath|Aftermath of the 2023 Guatemalan general election]]
**The office of the [[Guatemala Attorney General|Attorney General]] carries out raids in the offices of the [[Supreme Electoral Tribunal (Guatemala)|Supreme Electoral Tribunal]] and opens electoral boxes containing the electoral ballots. The Supreme Electoral Tribunal condemns the raids.
